examples: I felt ill.
The ill puppy slept.
She stayed home when she was ill.

more.def: Sick, or not feeling well in your body.
examples: He was ill with a cold and stayed in bed.
The nurse took care of the children who were ill.
Rest and water help when you are ill.
It is illegal to steal.
Running a red light is illegal.
Littering is illegal here.

more.def: Against the law, so that it is not allowed.
examples: It is illegal to drive without a license.
Dumping trash in the river is illegal.
Parking here is illegal because it blocks the road.
The illness lasted a week.
She missed school with an illness.
The illness went away.

more.def: A sickness, or a period of being sick.
examples: A long illness kept her out of school.
The doctor treated his illness.
Rest helped her recover from the illness.
The plan is illogical.
An illogical idea.
It is illogical to go in rain without a coat.
It is illogical to wear shorts in the snow.
The illogical plan made no sense.
His answer was illogical.
A lamp will illuminate the room.
The moon illuminated the path.
Candles illuminate the table.

more.def: To fill a place with light, or to make something clear.
examples: A bright lamp illuminated the dark room.
The moon illuminated the path through the woods.
A flash of lightning illuminated the whole sky.
The illumination was bright.
There was little illumination.
The room had good illumination.

more.def: Light, or the act of lighting up something.
examples: The illumination of the stage was bright.
There was little illumination in the dark cave.
Candles gave the room a soft illumination.

easy.def: Something that looks different from what it really is.
examples: The magic trick is an illusion.
The water on the road is an illusion.
The mirror trick is an illusion.

more.def: Something that seems to be real but is not, or that tricks the eye.
examples: The magician created the illusion of floating.
The puddle on the hot road was only an illusion.
The drawing is an optical illusion.

easy.def: To draw pictures for a story.
examples: I will illustrate my book with crayons.
She illustrates books for kids.
We illustrate our poems.

more.def: To add pictures to a book or story, or to explain with examples.
examples: The artist illustrated the story with bright watercolor paintings.
He illustrated his report with maps and photos.
The teacher used a story to illustrate her point.

related.def: A person who draws pictures for books.

examples: The book has an illustration.
I like the illustration.
The illustration is of a dog.

more.def: A picture in a book, magazine or other writing that helps explain or decorate it.
examples: The book has a colorful illustration on every page.
She drew an illustration of a dragon for the story.
The illustration shows how a plant grows.
